description: Lot de données de PPRN inondation en Charente (la Charente amont et l'Argentor) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Data set of the plan for the prevention of natural risks flooding the valleys of the upstream Charente and Argentor, Charente. Natural hazard prevention plans (NPPs) in Charente are drawn up for flood risk or land movement risk. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map Viewing Service (WMS) of the data batch: Data batch of PPRN flooding in Charente (the upstream Charente and Argentor" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.3.0, WMS 1.1.1. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2019-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
